name: Houzuki Suisen
source:
[url=/c161706]Houzuki Enju[/url]'s little sister. She is tall and boasts a model-like physique.
Her primary role is acting as Enju's assistant, and she is constantly keeping an eye on him.
While she completely lacked talent as a mage, her physical capabilities are high.

Because she knows her older brother is bound to the Houzuki family on her account, she has firmly resolved to take Enju's side no matter what happens.

She has an extreme brother complex, yet she never lets her romantic feelings for him leak out.
She refers to herself as a "little sister ninja maid", but what exactly a ninja maid is supposed to be remains a mystery.


[u]Magic Tool[/u]
[b]Cursed Blade "Zankyou" (妖刀『残響』)[/b]

In the era before humanity acquired B.E.G., a "Cursed Blade" was the primary means for warriors to combat monsters.
It is a rusted weapon from a bygone era, but better than nothing at all.

[Translated from [url=https://crystalia.amusecraft.com/totsulover/index.html#Character]official website[/url]]
